data.description: Owns the driver-independent adashi-storage-api crate: ProjectStorage, StorageBackend, StorageClient, StorageFactory and consistent ReadSnapshot methods across every domain. Shared typed mutations/results, canonical document tokens, version/reference checks and durable fingerprinted receipts are used by desktop and MCP. ProjectStore selects and delegates to the complete SQLite adapter; no production connection escapes. LocalDerivedCache separates disposable health/preview data; waivers and legacy content remain canonical. QA reservation, atomic claim and evidence commits surround external process execution. Desktop narrow design edits preserve hierarchy/endpoints within the guarded transaction. Operation map and intentional API changes: docs/storage-api-migration.md.
data.name: Shared Storage Core
